rules.name: EICAR_Standard_AV_Test_File
rules.description: Matches the official harmless European Institute for Computer Antivirus Research test string.

rules.name: High_Entropy_Packed_Section
rules.description: Identifies sections or artifacts with Shannon entropy exceeding 7.2, characteristic of UPX packing or byte encryption.

rules.name: Suspicious_Process_Injection_Imports
rules.description: Detects classic Win32 API combinations used for cross-process memory allocation and remote thread execution.

rules.name: NOP_Sled_Heuristic
rules.description: Detects byte sequence of repeated x86 NOP instructions (0x90) indicative of shellcode alignment.

rules.name: Obfuscated_PowerShell_Execution
rules.description: Detects encoded command execution flags and download cradles in script or artifact payloads.

rules.name: Suspicious_Network_Beacon_Indicators
rules.description: Detects hardcoded common C2 communication patterns or raw socket APIs in static artifacts.
